Test Description: Verifies reset default values and masked write/read behavior across the PCIe SII RC register set using documented defaults and masks.
Remarks: Only readable and writable registers are exercised. A specific PHY reset control register is excluded from default checks. Entries marked to skip are not accessed. Six data patterns are used.
Test Steps / Procedure:
1) For each readable register, read and compare to its documented default.
2) For each writable register, write each data pattern in sequence.
3) For each register with read and write access, read back and compare to the expected masked value.
4) Record any mismatches and determine the overall result as pass or fail.
Validation / Acceptance Criteria:
1) Default value read after reset → Equals the documented default.
2) Read after write on readable and writable registers → Equals the expected masked value derived from written data and preserved default.
3) Overall result → Pass if no mismatches are recorded; otherwise fail.

Feature: Configuration Space Access and Link Training Readiness
Test Description: This test configures coherency control, waits for link readiness, exercises configuration space BAR registers, and verifies completion through a handshake sequence. It confirms readiness and basic configuration access for the controller instances.
Remarks: Execution path depends on compile-time configuration. Status is polled until ready. A handshake must complete before exit.
Test Steps / Procedure:
1) Program coherency control fields in DBI_DSP_COHERENCY_CONTROL_3_OFF for both instances.
2) Poll the SII status register until link and readiness are indicated.
3) Write and read configuration space BAR registers and enable memory, IO, and bus mastering.
4) Repeat configuration operations for the second instance when enabled by build configuration.
5) Verify completion through a handshake register and finish when complete.
Validation / Acceptance Criteria:
1) Status indicates readiness → Proceed without error.
2) Handshake indicates completion → Test passes and finishes.
Hidden_Test_Description: Performs PCIe link training and configuration-space access verification. The test writes 0x0 to 0xE6004100, conditionally performs link training via link_training_dm0_x4(4) and/or link_training_dm1_x4(4) based on DM0_RC, DM1_RC, DM0_EP, DM1_EP. Coherency control programming: for PCIE0 and PCIE1, read mizar_PCIE{0,1}_DBI_DSP_COHERENCY_CONTROL_3_OFF, set fields (11..14)=0xF and (3..6)=0xF, write back; then set (27..30)=0xF and (19..22)=0xF, write back. After wait_on(20), recompute with all four fields and write back for both instances. Read SII0 status via data_rd = read_sii0_reg(0xC0); call non_secure_prot_nic(); loop while ((data_rd & 0xD1) != 0xD1) reading read_sii0_reg(0xC0) with optional DEBUG prints. If DM1_RC, similarly poll SII1 via read_sii1_reg(0xC0) until (data_rd & 0xD1) == 0xD1 with optional DEBUG prints. Write 0x11111111 to 0xE6004100; wait_on(15000). If DM0_RC: call mem_base_program_dm0_x4(); wait_on(10); optionally print; read the first 10 configuration dwords via read_pcie_slv0_reg(i*0x4) for i=0..9. First BAR write set: write_pcie_slv0_reg 0x10,0x14,0x18,0x1C,0x20,0x24 with 0xFFFFFFFF; then read back each with read_pcie_slv0_reg and print. Second BAR write set: write 0x10<-0x0, 0x14<-0x4, 0x18<-0x20000000, 0x1C<-0x40000000, 0x20<-0x60000000, 0x24<-0x80000000; read back and print each. Enable memory/IO/bus master via write_pcie_slv0_reg(0x4,0x7). If DM1_RC: call mem_base_program_dm1_x4(); read first 10 config dwords via read_pcie_slv1_reg(i*0x4); enable via write_pcie_slv1_reg(0x4,0x7); perform analogous 0xFFFFFFFF writes to 0x10..0x24 and readbacks; then program second value set at 0x10..0x24 and readbacks. Final wait_on(10); poll read_reg(0xE6004100) until it equals 0x12345678 (with intermittent wait_on(5) and optional prints). On success, finish(0).
Hidden_Remarks: Execution is controlled by compile-time flags DM0_RC, DM1_RC, DM0_EP, DM1_EP. SII readiness is determined by polling read_sii{0,1}_reg(0xC0) until (value & 0xD1) == 0xD1. Handshake register at 0xE6004100 is written and later polled until it reads 0x12345678. Memory, IO, and bus mastering are enabled by writing 0x7 to configuration offset 0x4. BAR offsets 0x10..0x24 are written with test patterns and read back for observation.
Hidden_Test_Steps_Procedure:
1) Initialize: write_reg(0xE6004100, 0x0).
2) Conditional link training based on defines:
   - If DM0_RC: link_training_dm0_x4(4).
   - If DM1_RC: link_training_dm1_x4(4).
   - If DM0_EP: link_training_dm0_x4(4).
   - If DM1_EP: link_training_dm1_x4(4).
3) DBI coherency programming for PCIe0:
   - rd_wr_data1 = set_data(read_reg(mizar_PCIE0_DBI_DSP_COHERENCY_CONTROL_3_OFF), 11, 14, 0xF);
   - rd_wr_data1 = set_data(rd_wr_data1, 3, 6, 0xF);
   - write_reg(mizar_PCIE0_DBI_DSP_COHERENCY_CONTROL_3_OFF, rd_wr_data1);
   - rd_wr_data1 = set_data(read_reg(mizar_PCIE0_DBI_DSP_COHERENCY_CONTROL_3_OFF), 27, 30, 0xF);
   - rd_wr_data1 = set_data(rd_wr_data1, 19, 22, 0xF);
   - write_reg(mizar_PCIE0_DBI_DSP_COHERENCY_CONTROL_3_OFF, rd_wr_data1).
4) DBI coherency programming for PCIe1 (same sequence using mizar_PCIE1_DBI_DSP_COHERENCY_CONTROL_3_OFF).
5) wait_on(20); recompute for both instances with all four fields set and write back.
6) Read SII0 status: data_rd = read_sii0_reg(0xC0); non_secure_prot_nic(); while ((data_rd & 0xD1) != 0xD1) { data_rd = read_sii0_reg(0xC0); optional DEBUG prints }.
7) If DM1_RC: data_rd = read_sii1_reg(0xC0); while ((data_rd & 0xD1) != 0xD1) { optional DEBUG prints; data_rd = read_sii1_reg(0xC0); }.
8) write_reg(0xE6004100, 0x11111111); wait_on(15000).
9) If DM0_RC: mem_base_program_dm0_x4(); wait_on(10); optional print; for (i=0..9) { rd_wr_data1 = read_pcie_slv0_reg(i*0x4); }.
10) Instance0 first BAR write set: write_pcie_slv0_reg(0x10,0xFFFFFFFF); 0x14<-0xFFFFFFFF; 0x18<-0xFFFFFFFF; 0x1C<-0xFFFFFFFF; 0x20<-0xFFFFFFFF; 0x24<-0xFFFFFFFF; then read each address (0x10,0x14,0x18,0x1C,0x20,0x24) and print.
11) Instance0 second BAR write set: write_pcie_slv0_reg(0x10,0x0); 0x14<-0x4; 0x18<-0x20000000; 0x1C<-0x40000000; 0x20<-0x60000000; 0x24<-0x80000000; then read each and print. Enable features via write_pcie_slv0_reg(0x4,0x7).
12) If DM1_RC: mem_base_program_dm1_x4(); optional print; for (i=0..9) { rd_wr_data1 = read_pcie_slv1_reg(i*0x4); }; enable via write_pcie_slv1_reg(0x4,0x7); write 0xFFFFFFFF to 0x10..0x24 and read back; write second set (0x0,0x4,0x20000000,0x40000000,0x60000000,0x80000000) to 0x10..0x24 and read back.
13) Finalization: wait_on(10); data_rd = read_reg(0xE6004100); while (data_rd != 0x12345678) { wait_on(5); optional print; data_rd = read_reg(0xE6004100); }; finish(0).
Hidden_Validation_Acceptance_Criteria:
1) SII readiness loop exits when (read_sii0_reg(0xC0) & 0xD1) == 0xD1; if DM1_RC is defined, also when (read_sii1_reg(0xC0) & 0xD1) == 0xD1.
2) Final handshake loop exits when read_reg(0xE6004100) == 0x12345678.
3) On successful exit of both conditions, the test calls finish(0).
